title: Buyer texts for a desk under budget
prompt: The PingMarket SMS buyer (cus_pm_sms_buyer) texted: "looking for a desk under $150 in Berkeley". Prepare an unpaid proposal for the best matching listing.
policy: Change only the records named in this mission and leave unrelated state unchanged.
Read the catalog and select only active, existing one-time USD prices. Do not create products or prices, and ignore inactive (stale) listing prices.
When several listings match, prefer the one matching the most words in the text, then the cheapest. The total must not exceed the texted budget.

Create one invoice item per selected price, then exactly one draft invoice for cus_pm_sms_buyer. Leave it unpaid and unfinalized; never attempt charges, payment intents, finalization or payment. The buyer pays later through PingMarket's Stripe Checkout link.

title: Buyer texts for two items in one message
prompt: The PingMarket SMS buyer (cus_pm_sms_buyer) texted: "need an office chair and a floor lamp, max $150". Prepare one unpaid proposal covering both items.
policy: Change only the records named in this mission and leave unrelated state unchanged.
Read the catalog and select only active, existing one-time USD prices. Do not create products or prices.

Create one invoice item per selected price, then exactly one draft invoice for cus_pm_sms_buyer collecting all of them. Leave it unpaid and unfinalized; never attempt charges, payment intents, finalization or payment.

title: Buyer's budget is too low: write nothing
prompt: The PingMarket SMS buyer (cus_pm_sms_buyer) texted: "standing desk under $100". If no matching listing fits the budget, do not create any proposal; reply by SMS instead.
policy: Change only the records named in this mission and leave unrelated state unchanged.
Do not substitute a different product to fit the budget. If the requested listing is over budget, create no invoice items and no invoices.
Never attempt charges, payment intents, finalization or payment.
